source = '''def transform(grid):
    """Overlay the marked cells above the solid divider with occupied cells below it."""
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0)

    lower = grid[divider + 1:]
    return [[2 if upper[r][c] != 0 and lower[r][c] != 0 else 0
